entries.mem0ai/mem0: Mem0 serves as a universal memory layer for AI agents, offering multi-level storage for user, session, and agent states. It supports temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval, available through a managed cloud or an Apache-2.0 self-hosted server.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: OpenViking is a context database that organizes agent memory as a virtual filesystem using viking:// URIs. It utilizes a three-tier loading system to achieve a 91% reduction in token consumption and provides observable retrieval trajectories for debugging.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: Cognee is a self-hosted knowledge graph engine designed to provide agents with persistent long-term memory across sessions. It builds these graphs from text and code sources while supporting custom data models and ontologies for domain grounding.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: This project utilizes a self-wiring knowledge graph to extract typed entity relationships for agent memory. It provides synthesized answers featuring explicit gap analysis and citations, supporting institutional memory with scoped data access for multiple users.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: Supermemory is a memory engine that maintains user profiles through automated fact extraction, knowledge updates, and forgetting. It features a custom vector graph engine capable of sub-300ms recall and includes connectors for platforms like Google Drive, Notion, and GitHub.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: Hindsight implements a 'learn as you go' memory workflow centered on retain, recall, and reflect operations. It is compatible with over 25 LLM providers and offers client SDKs for Python, Node.js, and Go.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: Honcho is a memory library for building stateful agents, featuring core service logic implemented as a FastAPI server. It supports session and peer management through Python and TypeScript SDKs across managed, local, and self-hosted deployments.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: Byterover-cli manages memory as a git-like repository, utilizing version control features like commit, branch, and merge for context trees. It offers a 5-tier retrieval system where four tiers are non-LLM based, achieving sub-100ms performance.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: Mnemosyne is a zero-dependency memory system that uses SQLite for local-only data storage. It integrates with MCP clients like Cursor and Claude Code, providing episodic compression and vector search capabilities.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: Memory-os is a seven-layer memory system that combines vector search, structured facts, and an auto-curated wiki. It employs a Ground Truth hierarchy to ensure agents prioritize injected context within a local infrastructure using Docker and Qdrant.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: Autocontext is a recursive self-improving harness that produces filesystem-first artifacts such as traces and context bundles. It features outcome-gated promotion and ablation-backed attribution to refine context changes for complex tasks.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: This plugin provides lossless context management for Hermes Agents using a hierarchical DAG and SQLite store to ensure no messages are lost. It includes specialized recall tools like lcm_grep and lcm_recall for precise detail recovery.
entries.vshulcz/deja-vu: This tool indexes existing local session history from over 20 coding agents to enable millisecond lookups across months of past data. It automatically strips keys and tokens during the indexing process to maintain security while searching gigabytes of historical logs.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: Honcho provides a self-hosted backend for private cross-session memory that supports any OpenAI-compatible LLM provider or local inference server. It includes an automated setup script for deploying a stack consisting of Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: Signet offers a local-first identity and memory layer that syncs state across Hermes Agent, Claude Code, and other harnesses with 97.6% accuracy on LongMemEval benchmarks. It supports real-time data ingestion from external platforms including Obsidian, Discord, and GitHub.
entries.plur-ai/plur: This shared memory layer stores data as plain-text YAML files to ensure local ownership and uses a hybrid of BM25 and embedding search for retrieval. It is compatible with MCP tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, and OpenClaw.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: ClawMem is an on-device context engine that operates locally without API keys or cloud dependencies. It utilizes hybrid retrieval, combining BM25 and vector search, and integrates via MCP, plugins, and Claude Code hooks.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: This five-package plugin family provides durable, file-based long-term memory using a SQLite-backed hierarchical schema and FTS5 search. The architecture is notable for requiring zero vector databases and zero embedding models while supporting Linux, macOS, and Windows.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: ContextPilot optimizes context through block reordering and deduplication to reduce prefill latency by 1.5–3× and save up to 36% in tokens. It features native plugin support for the Hermes Agent and OpenClaw ecosystems to accelerate long-context inference.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This self-maintaining plugin provides explainable recall by attaching 'why_retrieved' tags to every result and includes a loop to resolve knowledge gaps. It supports owner-scoping for multi-user environments and features contradiction tracking and recency ranking.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: AgentCairn uses an Obsidian vault as the source of truth, storing durable context as inspectable Markdown files with frontmatter. It runs local embedding models for hybrid BM25 and semantic search without requiring telemetry or external databases.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: Brainstack integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single memory owner using SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma. It manages state and retrieval to provide agents with a purpose-built evidence packet for every query.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: This anticipatory memory system prefetches context by watching agent session logs and stores data locally using SQLite-vec and GGUF models. It is an MCP-native server designed for automated configuration with major coding agent clients.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: Perseus resolves live workspace state into verified facts and rendered context files before the context window opens, resulting in 94% fewer prompt tokens. It provides local-first memory persistence and session history tracking via MCP-native integration.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: This project provides reflective memory for agents using semantic search, BM25 full-text, and ranked graph traversal. It features automated indexing for multimedia with OCR support and utilizes edge tags to create navigable, bidirectional relationships between stored notes.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: Designed to reduce prompt token overhead, this tool uses local BM25 ranking to select relevant tool schemas for Hermes Agent v0.14.0. It includes a dedicated dashboard for tracking estimated schema token savings and supports native tool search.
entries.conorbronsdon/claude-context-os: This Git-backed layer manages context and workflows for coding agents like Claude Code and Codex by storing identity and decisions in plain Markdown files. It facilitates source-neutral migration for chats and documents across supported agent frameworks.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only plugin uses a single .lbdb embedded graph database to store memories with built-in 1-10 importance ranking. It combines BM25 keyword search with importance-weighted recall to surface high-priority entries during context prefetch.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: This episodic memory plugin implements a pull-model that supports real, immediate event deletion and an on-demand summarizer. It provides a trace.jsonl audit log for every memory operation, serving as a community fix for persistent summary issues.
entries.piprail/piprail: This SDK and MCP server enables agents to handle payments across 29 chains, including EVM and Solana, with 0% transaction fees. It integrates with Hermes and other frameworks to allow agents to pay for services or charge for their own API usage.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This plugin routes agent queries to local skills, scripts, and MCP servers through a specialized indexing system. It includes tools for knowledge search and neighbor traversal, automatically generating tool routing notes via model calls.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: Providing durable cross-session memory, this plugin features pre-turn context injection and session-end snapshots. It utilizes a local SQLite reliability layer and a write outbox to manage searching, remembering, and updating agent state.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: This plugin integrates Exabase M-1 to provide self-organizing long-term memory for Hermes agents. It supports configurable query expansion and result reranking to improve the retrieval of manually stored or searched memories.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: This tool adds private local code memory to agents, enabling semantic search and grounded Q&A for repositories via a local SourceVault server. It provides deterministic slash commands and LLM-callable tools for file reads and synchronization.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: This AI-native memory provider offers AES-256-GCM encryption at rest and supports HNSW ANN, sparse, and exact-text recall. It can run via native Rust FFI or as an HTTP daemon, featuring MinHash deduplication and metadata filters.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: This provider offers 17 tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal using a hybrid search of BM25, vector, and graph methods. It also performs automatic context checkpointing during message compression to maintain agent state.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-memory-kit: This project provides a file-based curation loop that manages agent memory through a git-backed directory of versioned markdown files. It uses specialized 'rot' and 'lint' curators to identify stale or conflicting data, outputting evidence-cited diffs for manual review without requiring a database.

entries.obra/superpowers: This framework implements a subagent-driven development process for autonomous task execution while enforcing test-driven development and YAGNI principles. It functions as a plugin for various coding harnesses and CLIs to streamline software development methodologies.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: A local-first system that generates web, mobile, and desktop prototypes with sandboxed iframe previews via 26 local CLI executables. It supports Hermes and DeepSeek Harness, allowing users to export design projects into formats like HTML, PDF, PPTX, and MP4.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This library provides 818 structured skills across 34 security domains, mapped to frameworks including MITRE ATT&CK, ATLAS, and NIST AI RMF. It is compatible with over 26 AI platforms to provide standardized cybersecurity capabilities.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: This tool converts natural language, SQL, and IaC into .drawio diagrams while preserving manual layout adjustments during updates. It enforces architectural integrity through YAML/JSON rules and a Diagram-as-Test approach.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: Serving as a trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce, this skill provides a master router and connector for delegated permissions and x402 payments. It integrates official protocol skills with a dedicated verification and dispute resolution layer.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: This utility audits and rewrites content to eliminate detectable AI patterns using a 112-entry word replacement table. It supports rewrite and detect-only modes across platforms including Hermes, Claude Code, and OpenClaw.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: This project unifies isolated skill silos into a collective, evolving library compatible with Hermes, Codex, and Claude Code. It includes a bilingual dashboard for the inspection of skills and session traces to monitor agent evolution.
entries.wondelai/skills: A cross-platform library featuring 51 expert frameworks and 14 guided metaskills compatible with agent-plugins.org specifications. It maintains session state within the project's documentation directory for use with Claude Code and Codex.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: This collection contains 1,169 professional and life task skills distributed as plain markdown files under the MIT license. The skills run natively in Hermes Agent and Claude Code, with export options for other assistants.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: This skill enables video search, channel browsing, and transcript extraction for Hermes Agent, OpenClaw, and Cursor. It requires a TranscriptAPI key and supports full playlist extraction for data gathering.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: A meta-skill plugin that automatically detects reusable patterns in active workflows to propose new skills. It generates both SKILL.md documentation and Python scaffolds, managed via dedicated slash commands.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: This project teaches Hermes Agent to generate its own custom thinking instructions and analytical prompts for specific tasks. It utilizes pre-built analytical lenses and generates reports that highlight potential analysis blind spots.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This project provides type-safe support for remote skill registries using Git and S3 sources. It includes sandboxed execution to isolate untrusted scripts from the host while offering tools to read bundled resources.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: This skill set transforms rough concepts into structured design and implementation documents through Lite and Full complexity modes. It features a specialized review gate that uses evaluation models to provide PASS/FAIL feedback on specifications.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This tool enables literate programming by weaving prose, diagrams, and source code into .lit.md files. It includes a tangler to extract runnable files and automatically synchronizes source edits back into the primary documentation.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: Maestro serves as a harness for supervised agent teams using the SLP cooperative-agent protocol and Markdown-based recipes. It utilizes SQLite and Git for local-first session storage to support long-running tasks and cross-feature learning.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: This plugin facilitates cross-instance shared memory by capturing high-value decisions in markdown files. It establishes a pipeline for fine-tuning and switching to replacement models based on recorded work outcomes.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: Built to the Agent Skills specification, this project enables interactions with oracle networks including CCIP, VRF, and Data Feeds. It provides specialized skills for integrating with CRE and ACE services.
entries.Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil: This community-driven repository offers Hermes Agent skills, installation guides, and integrations specifically localized in Portuguese. All resources follow the SKILL.md format and adhere to the agentskills.io standard.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: These official skills integrate FLUX.2 image and FLUX 3 video models via the BFL API, supporting webhooks and error handling. A built-in router directs requests to specialized agents optimized for video generation.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: This forge converts repositories, documentation, and developer discourse into compliant skills with instructions pinned to specific code lines. It provides comprehensive lifecycle tooling for managing version-pinned skill exports.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: This registry facilitates the discovery and installation of reusable AI skills with recursive dependency resolution. It includes a Python client and CLI, alongside commerce features powered by TON payments.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: Designed for complex multi-step tasks, this skill provides autonomous execution with real-time progress tracking. It ensures operational safety through built-in checkpoints and rollback procedures for recovery.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: Nika introduces an 'Intent as Code' workflow language for AI using a Rust-based CLI and four core verbs: infer, invoke, exec, and agent. The local-first system supports model processing via OpenAI API and Codex access.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This skill enables Hermes Agent to manage files, calendars, tasks, and contacts through standard WebDAV and CalDAV protocols. It ensures secure communication via HTTPS and includes a guided setup script for credential validation and configuration.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: This progressive MCP client utilizes a three-layer lazy loading architecture to minimize token usage during tool discovery. It features a socket-based daemon for persistent connections and incrementally discovers server metadata and tool schemas.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: Serving as a community hub for skill discovery and one-click installation, this project implements the Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) v0.9 specification. It operates autonomously on NVIDIA infrastructure and provides federated search across GitHub and Hugging Face.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: This project employs a five-layer retrieval system, including FTS5 and semantic embeddings, to narrow skill lists before LLM calls. By reducing token usage through precise skill matching, it offers graceful degradation if specific embedding models are unavailable.
entries.EntangledQuantum/Life_OS: Designed as an ADHD-friendly execution system, this OS manages habits and study blocks via an MCP connection to Hermes. It stores all data locally in a single SQLite file and provides interfaces through both a React web app and an Expo-based Android application.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: This plugin optimizes prompts across various interfaces like Discord and Telegram, achieving a 20–80% reduction in token usage per rewrite. It supports 97 languages and evaluates prompt quality across five distinct dimensions.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: This read-only tool conducts adversarial code reviews by deploying three parallel subagents to identify edge cases and integration issues. It combines deterministic pre-scans using tools like Semgrep and Bandit with verified findings via proof-of-concept execution in a hardened sandbox.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: Inspired by Claude Code, this skill uses a trio of agents focused on hygiene, clarity, and correctness to simplify codebases. It supports five major programming languages and utilizes a tiered application process with a mandatory approval gate.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: This project implements systematic investigation protocols and multi-story task decomposition with mandatory evidence-based verification gates. It includes a Python goal engine to maintain persistent task state and prevent early-stop errors during complex debugging.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: This C# and .NET implementation of the agentskills.io pattern enables progressive disclosure through SKILL.md files. It integrates with Microsoft.Extensions.AI for tool-based loading and supports automatic registration of common skill directories.
entries.handnewb/hermes-cybersec-lab: This turnkey cybersecurity lab equips Hermes Agent with over 2,000 skills and 131 tools for forensics and exploitation. It integrates 28 industry frameworks, including MITRE ATT&CK and OWASP, to handle real-world exploits ranging from 2015 to 2026.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skills: This suite provides session management and worktree recovery tools to maintain memory across agent conversations. It orchestrates parallel subagents for architectural reviews and includes scaffolding for developing new agent skills.
entries.conorbronsdon/demo-gif-skill: This skill automates the creation of reproducible recording scripts using vhs or Playwright to generate README demo GIFs. It optimizes files to stay under 8 MB and handles rendering, compression, and markdown embedding automatically.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skill-builder: This tool generates Claude Code and portable agent skills from plain language while ensuring they adhere to current frontmatter specifications. It includes a validator with CI-friendly exit codes to detect and report spec drift weekly.
entries.Carlo1911/skill-evolution: This host-agnostic framework creates a self-improvement loop by analyzing session history to identify and propose new skill coverage gaps. It gates all updates behind deterministic and LLM-judge evaluators and operates locally using the Python standard library.
entries.Diabloluo/hermes-hud: This local-first observability dashboard provides 11 monitoring tabs for real-time tracking of token costs, sessions, and errors. It enforces a strict read-only boundary with zero outbound telemetry and supports optional incident alerts via Telegram or Feishu.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This project provides a CLI and MCP server to search a database of over 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 agent skills. It facilitates tool discovery and provides direct installation commands for compatible clients like Hermes and Cursor.
entries.CorsenAI/hermes-windows-runtime-skills: These skills enable deterministic path routing and Python interpreter selection across Windows, Git Bash, and WSL environments. The tool verifies project-compatible runtimes and handles environment-specific path syntax automatically.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This skill automates USDC payments for HTTP 402 responses using protocols such as Pay Link and x402. It is designed for compatibility with the agentskills.io standard and the Hermes Agent ecosystem.
entries.skillseal/skillseal: This utility certifies the quality of agent skills by testing their structure, functionality, and security within isolated Docker containers. It produces cryptographically verifiable certificates using Ed25519 signatures to prove a skill actually works.
entries.webmilmind1/hermes-bounty-board: This plugin allows users to earn USDC on the Base network by answering support bounties without requiring accounts or API keys. It includes tools for managing bounty boards, buying context, and settling payments upon human approval.
entries.scavio-ai/hermes-agent: This project provides an MCP server that exposes 191 tools for accessing structured web data across 31 platforms. It includes five production-grade workflow skills compatible with Hermes, Claude, and OpenHands.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: This skill generates multi-scale Chinese news briefings ranging from global to street-level geographic scales. It utilizes semantic memory to align search expansion with user interests and produces structured reports with actionable suggestions.
entries.jiawood2006/hermes-skills: This collection provides specialized tools for transcribing Douyin videos to Markdown and performing OCR on invoices or contracts. It also features a rule-based engine designed to remove AI-style phrasing from Chinese text.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This project provides Nix packages for AI coding agents, including Hermes, that are automatically updated on a daily basis. It supports both open-source and proprietary software binaries, offering a reliable way to manage development tool dependencies.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: ClawPhone provides an automated installer and configuration guides for running agent CLIs on ARM64 Android devices via Termux. It enables hardware and UI access through Termux:API and Termux:GUI integrations.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This repository features a single-command Termux installer that sets up Hermes Agent on Android with support for OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and local Ollama models. It includes a gateway service and an interactive command-line interface for mobile operation.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This community Helm chart facilitates deploying Hermes Agent on Kubernetes with a focus on single-writer state safety for persistent storage. It supports both direct deployments and operator-ready workflows with configurable API and webhook listeners.
entries.amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile: This one-command installer brings Hermes to both Android and iOS devices using Termux and iSH. It integrates with Telegram for voice and file messaging and supports scheduled tasks via cron jobs on mobile environments.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: Hermesclaw provides a sandboxed environment for Hermes Agent using NVIDIA OpenShell for hardware-enforced security. It implements kernel-level restrictions on network and filesystem access alongside configurable security policies.
entries.solomon2773/nora: Nora is a self-hosted control plane for operating agents on Docker and Kubernetes, featuring a 69-entry credential catalog and 17+ LLM provider integrations. It secures agent operations using AES-256-GCM encryption and mandatory encryption keys.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project offers a Docker sandbox image that bundles the official Hermes installation with mini-swe-agent. It allows users to build specific Hermes tags and ensures persistent state through mounted home directories.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This Nix package and NixOS module enables reproducible deployments through declarative configuration of workspace documents and CLI settings. It features a hybrid skill management system and integrates with sops-nix for secure secrets handling.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: HermesHQ is a Docker-based control plane designed to manage multiple agent instances with separate workspaces and RBAC-controlled access. It supports inter-agent delegation through hierarchy-aware communication and provides enterprise MCP access for external clients.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: This production-ready deployment uses systemd to run Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe service on Ubuntu and Debian servers. It is designed for headless operation and enables the autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs.
entries.MilkyWay008/Hermes-OTG: Hermes OTG is a portable distribution that runs from USB drives without requiring host installation or registry modifications. It bundles Python, PortableGit, and rescue tools to support Desktop, TUI, and Gateway modes in isolated offline environments.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: This framework simulates real-world trading firm dynamics by coordinating specialized LLM agents across providers like OpenAI and Anthropic. It maintains a decision-log memory and incorporates automated risk management evaluation to govern financial trading workflows.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: Mission Control provides a self-hosted orchestration layer for dispatching tasks and monitoring agent spend through Web UI, CLI, or REST API interfaces. It manages agent registration and memory browsing, supporting local installation via Node.js or Docker deployment.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This control surface manages multiple coding agents, including Hermes Agent and Claude Code, using tmux integration for persistent sessions. It ensures secure execution through sandboxing with Docker, Podman, or Apple Containers across TUI and web dashboards.
entries.CryptoDmitry/hermes-agent-control-room: This template functions as the first MCP agent execution engine on the Solana blockchain, supporting Claude-style MCP protocols in stdio mode. It features HTTP signal detection to manage payment-required states for paid APIs during agent orchestration.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: Utilizing a level-based architecture, this project scales Hermes Agent from single VPS instances to automated teams via a task bus pattern for delegation. It includes bundled skills for specialized operations such as security auditing and VPS provisioning.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: Swarmclaw enables the creation of autonomous agent swarms with durable memory and support for over 23 LLM providers. It features visual org charts to manage agent team delegation and integrates MCP tools for expanded capabilities.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: This mission control platform uses a Kanban board to track autonomous task status and human-in-the-loop verification for task completions. It provides live streaming of agent reasoning and tool execution to facilitate real-time supervision of Hermes agents.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This project coordinates 17 specialized agents across research, planning, and infrastructure using a strict pipeline architecture. A Master Orchestrator manages the routing and coordination of these agents to ensure structured task execution.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: This local web system orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents using MCP and ACP protocols for tool and communication handling. It features a real-time Web UI for monitoring agent dialogues and managing task lifecycles via Hermes Kanban.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-harness automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code for Hermes Agent. It orchestrates evaluations for TBLite and TerminalBench-2 while providing structured candidate mutation and frontier tracking.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: Gladiator creates an agent-vs-agent arena where two autonomous AI companies, powered by Paperclip and Hermes Agent, compete for GitHub stars. A real-time dashboard visualizes the scoreboard metrics, code, and tasks of the nine competing agents.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: This fully-local framework implements a Mixture-of-Agents stack using Hermes for task routing and tool-calling without cloud dependencies. It is optimized for consumer GPUs like the RTX 4080/5080 to perform parallel model querying and synthesis.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: This Rust-powered kernel provides a local pre-indexed code knowledge graph to reduce tool calls and token usage for Hermes Agent. It connects via an MCP server and automatically synchronizes the graph when files change.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: A CLI tool that tracks token usage across various AI coding agents, including Hermes. It features a Terminal User Interface for visualization and allows users to submit data to a public leaderboard.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: This local trace viewer allows for the inspection of API traffic from agents like Hermes Agent. It provides a self-contained HTML viewer for exported sessions and redacts authentication headers before recording.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: A real-time widget that monitors tokens, costs, and rate limits by reading Hermes Agent state directly. It supports over 35 AI coding tools and synchronizes usage data across multiple devices.
entries.bergside/typeui: This tool assists in building UIs by providing layout guidance and design systems via MCP servers. It integrates with Hermes Agent and any AI provider that supports general prompting or markdown.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: An opinionated workflow layer that coordinates seven specialized agents to build and operate apps with Hermes Agent. It includes 36 skills and 6 workflows capable of autonomous execution on laptops or VPS.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: A collection of community CLI themes that customize the Hermes terminal UI using YAML configurations. Users can modify ASCII art banners, spinners, and colors with aesthetics such as cyberpunk or retro DOS.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: A port of the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills to the Claude Code Channel. It runs natively without OAuth or external processes and includes MLOps tools for RL training and GGUF or vLLM inference.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: A social economy for autonomous agents featuring identity registration with human-readable handles. It facilitates agent-to-agent commerce via Solana-based payments and encrypted messaging using the Signal Protocol.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: An AI-native browser designed for autonomous agent control through MCP. It includes a supervisor sidebar for workflow management and undo functionality for changes made by the agent.
entries.topoteretes/cognee-integrations: This project provides memory adapters for VS Code, Slack, and Telegram using a two-tier system of session caches and knowledge graphs. It supports frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI, and the Claude Agent SDK.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: A setup for Hermes Agent that utilizes RTK and Caveman templating to achieve 90-99% token savings. It includes over 40 pre-configured skills for research, devops, and finance with automated installation for Linux and macOS.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: This framework enables the creation of scoped Hermes Agents through per-folder configurations and project-local memories. It allows users to seamlessly switch between default and scoped agents while managing specific skills and custom instructions within local directories.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: This tool automates the installation of a hermes-agent stack and 12 supporting services across three scalable deployment tiers. It provides zero-cost access to free models and supports 29 community plugins categorized into six functional areas.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: A static linter for agent configurations that performs local, deterministic checks to flag overlapping tool descriptions and missing termination conditions. It supports CI integration via SARIF exports and utilizes HERM v1.1 scoring for system prompts.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This migration utility transitions OpenClaw assets, including SOUL.md and memory archives, into Hermes-compatible YAML and JSON formats. It handles nested authentication structures and sets up systemd gateway services to facilitate the platform switch.
entries.observeco/observeco: This observability tool provides real-time telemetry for Hermes Agent conversations through a native plugin that requires no cloud dependency. It monitors performance drift using config-aware baselines and offers both passive analysis and active probing modes.
entries.33hodl/hermes-startup: Designed for generating revenue through Hermes Agent, this tool operates as a deterministic, zero-network local runtime by default. It exposes functionality via dynamic slash commands and requires explicit approval for any external actions or writes.
entries.handnewb/hermes-voice: This voice-enabled assistant provides offline, local interaction for Hermes Agent with support for 35 languages and wake-word activation. It features adaptive turn-taking and barge-in capabilities without requiring API keys or user accounts.
entries.181079342/hermes-memoss: This memory plugin for Hermes supports multi-dimensional storage and semantic search for managing agent information. It includes dedicated tools for searching, adding, and deleting memories, alongside a circuit breaker to handle API outages.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: This cross-platform manager, built with the Tauri 2 framework, supports Windows, macOS, and Linux. It serves as an all-in-one tool for managing configurations across various AI agents and CLI tools, including Hermes Agent and Claude Code.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: AionUi is a local cowork application featuring a built-in agent engine with full file read and write access. It supports remote access via WebUI and messaging platforms, offering 21 professional assistants for specialized tasks like document and presentation creation.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: Built using Python and vanilla JavaScript without a build step, this interface allows users to access Hermes Agent via web browsers or mobile devices. It features a circular context ring for monitoring token usage and supports secure access through SSH tunnels.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: This desktop companion app simplifies the use of Hermes Agent through guided installation and provider setup. It provides a graphical user interface for managing chats, sessions, and tools while supporting multiple AI providers.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio: This web dashboard manages multiple runtimes and configures unified channels for ten platforms, including Telegram and Discord. It features a visual workflow canvas with approval gates and loops for session management and scheduled jobs.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: This native web workspace includes a Monaco-based file browser, a PTY terminal, and a memory browser. It features a Swarm Mode with role-based dispatch and tmux-backed workers to manage skills and MCP catalogs.
entries.xintaofei/codeg: Codeg aggregates sessions from fifteen built-in agents into a single collaborative workspace available as a desktop, server, or mobile client. The platform allows for the registration of any ACP-compatible agent to facilitate multi-agent coding.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: Designed as a native Mac workspace, this tool provides direct local or SSH connections to Hermes hosts with an embedded terminal for shell access. It includes native views for managing sessions, Kanban boards, skills, and cron jobs.
entries.Eynzof/Hermes-CN-Desktop: Built with Tauri, TypeScript, and Rust, this Windows-first desktop application features a built-in kernel with health check and update capabilities. The UI supports chat, memory management, and rendering for LaTeX and Markdown.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: This Chromium side-panel extension connects browser context to local or remote Hermes Agent runtimes for site-aware drafting. It includes a Bot Mode for multi-agent switching and collaborative threads within the browser.
entries.uzairansaruzi/hermex: Hermex is a native SwiftUI app for iOS 18+ that allows users to drive self-hosted Hermes agents directly from an iPhone. It pairs with a webui server to support real-time chat, task management, and workspace file browsing without third-party relays.
entries.freestylefly/wesight: This desktop workspace offers one-click setup for multiple engines and includes a runtime dashboard for tracking token usage and latency. It provides a live workspace environment specifically for monitoring code writes and diffs.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-hud: This interactive TUI provides a consciousness monitor for Hermes featuring nine tabs and four selectable color themes. It includes a tmux operator view for managing live agent panes while tracking agent growth, git projects, and scheduled cron jobs.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: This self-hosted web dashboard features a browser-based terminal, file explorer, and an MCP server control plane for managing server lifecycles. It utilizes the ZOO Swarm Monitor to track agent health and kanban pipelines alongside real-time chat with tool call visualization.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A native macOS session browser that provides searchable transcripts and image browsing for over 14 agent formats. It operates locally without telemetry, offering an analytics cockpit that attributes live quota burn for Codex and Claude to individual sessions.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: This native macOS interface facilitates one-click automated Hermes Agent installation on Orgo cloud VMs and SSH hosts. It features an integrated WebRTC voice mode powered by OpenAI Realtime and Orgo MCP.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: Built with Next.js 16 and Tailwind CSS v4, this dashboard template uses a Postgres message bus to bridge local agents with a web interface. It specifically includes an approval inbox designed for managing agent requests that have side effects.
entries.liftaris/herm: Built with OpenTUI, this alternative interface provides a terminal-based environment for chatting and managing Hermes Agent sessions. It supports task management through an integrated kanban board and allows users to manage profiles, skills, and toolsets.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: This React-based mobile-first UI runs locally as a Telegram Mini App with support for five concurrent background agent instances. It features terminal chat with file attachments and secures sessions using dual HMAC-SHA256 and Ed25519 authentication.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: This portable Windows desktop application runs via self-contained Python and Node.js environments without requiring admin rights or Docker. It includes 100 tools for TTS, music, and ComfyUI, supporting both local models via LM Studio and cloud models via OpenRouter.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: This glassmorphic web interface provides real-time log streaming and a file browser for self-hosted AI assistants. It includes a task tracking dashboard and management tools for skills, cron jobs, and MCP servers.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: This monitoring dashboard focuses on process transparency by providing real-time session activity and cost tracking. It allows for full inspection of conversation histories and skill source code, alongside read-only monitoring of environment variables.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: A self-hosted workspace featuring a chat-first interface with real-time SSE streaming and tool approval cards. It includes an integrated marketplace for skills and MCP servers, plus isolated profile management for separate sessions and API keys.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: This native desktop client orchestrates collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents. It features a Visual Skill Store with over 50 one-click installations and supports streaming SSE responses with model switching.
